about.title: About Us
about.bodyHtml:
Welcome to Willow Weave, women’s clothing brand which offers both casual and
formal wear that is as unique and remarkable as our highly valued and select
clientele. A brand, where every thread tells a story of elegance and comfort. We
believe in the power of exceptional clothing to inspire confidence and express
individuality. Our commitment to quality, value and timeless style makes us more
than just a brand. Willow Weave is a name where we weave our expertise into
enduring elegance designed for the women who value both style and substance.

We think that clothing is more than just a fabric; it is reflection of your inner strength
and individual style. So, we choose only the finest fabric and pay close attention to
every detail, ensuring that our garment not only look beautiful but also comfortable
to wear and stand the test of time. We focus on exquisite fabrics, apply thoughtful
designs and convert them into alluring fit, ensuring that each garment becomes
memorable part of your wardrobe besides truly reflecting your unique personality.

At Willow Weave, we are dedicated to produce beautiful, high-quality clothing that
make you feel confident and inspired, no matter the occasion. That’s why every
dress is thoughtfully designed and meticulously crafted. Willow Weave understands
present-day woman’s need for clothing that could transition beautifully from day to
night functions and from relaxed gatherings to formal events. This flexibility is also
woven in our aim to offer you exceptional style for every facet of your life, ensuring
you always feel confident and chic, no matter the occasion.

philosophy.title: Philosophy Behind Logo
philosophy.bodyHtml:
Why We Chose Symbol of Willow Tree as Logo

Selection of Willow tree as Willow Weave’s logo is very thoughtful and deliberate. In nature’s tapestry, the Willow tree silently stands as a powerful emblem. It is as diverse as it is ubiquitous with hundreds of species. A Willow tree stands for qualities like strength and solace during life’s most memorable events. Willow tree also encourages expression of profound emotions.

 Willows have a long life and new trees are easily planted from its branch cuttings. That’s how it symbolizes its growth potential. Like a wise mother or grandmother, it whispers to us to adjust and bend gracefully rather than resist the winds of change. It reminds us, much like Willow tree’s branches surrender to the wind in order to avoid breaking, bending during the most challenging times is important to endure.

Willow tree’s flexible boughs inspire us to be adaptable in the face of challenges. In the gentle rustle of its leaves and sturdy embrace of its branches, the Willow tree offers a profound reminder that even during inevitable storms, there is resilience, hope, grace and strength. The Willow’s ability to thrive in challenging conditions is a poignant metaphor for the resilience of the human spirit.

 Beyond individual strength, the Willow tree teaches us the power of unity in community. A single Willow branch may flex and bow, but a bundle of branches forms an unyielding force. As we think about the symbolism of the Willow tree, its graceful presence becomes a testament to the beauty of adaptability and the strength in vulnerability. Embracing the wisdom of Willow tree, we find the way towards life’s most important moments. Like a Willow tree, we ought to have deep roots in our community and we need to move with the winds of change. Our name and visual identity reflect our work and define our presence in the women clothing market in order to ensure our long-term sustainability and expansion.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy policy
privacy-policy.bodyHtml:
Privacy Policy

At Willow Weave, we ensure that your privacy is protected when buying online using our services. This website is being managed by willowweave.co and its privacy policy applies to the use of website itself and any of the connected Social Media Pages or Platforms using willowweave.co. So, willow weave’s privacy policy explains what personal information is, how we use this information, who has access to the data and your rights regarding collected information. Your access and use of willowoweave.co tantamount to your acceptance of our privacy policy and terms of use. Please read our privacy policy carefully to get a clear understanding of how we collect, use, protect or otherwise handle your personal information. We will not sell or redistribute your information to anyone.

Personal Data and Its Use

We use the information that we collect to fulfill our commitment(s) to you and to provide you with the service(s) that you expect from willowweave.co. This includes sending you information and offers for marketing purposes. In order to provide you with relevant offers and information, we may analyze your personal data. We only keep your data as long as necessary to carry out our service(s) to you and/or required by the law. 

Willowweave.co Collects Personal Information

When you are placing an order or registering on our site or subscribe to updates or leave a message on customer service, whichever the case may be, you may be required to enter your name, contact number, email address, payment/ credit card details, mailing address or other details in order to provide you our service(s).

Use and Storage of Your Personal Information

We may use the information we collect from you when you register, make a purchase, sign up for our newsletter, respond to a survey or marketing communication, surf the website or use certain other site features as following:-

• In order to process orders and share information and updates pertaining to your order(s).

• To be able to send text message/ notification(s) of delivery status.

• Be able to contact you if there’s any problem with the delivery of your item(s).

• To process your transaction(s) smoothly and quickly.

• To ask for ratings and reviews of services or products.

• To personalize your experience and allow willowweave.co to deliver content or product offering(s) of your interest.

• To allow willowweave.co to better serve you in responding to your customer service request(s).

Sharing of Information with Third Parties by Willowweave.co

Willowweave.co may share your personal information with third parties or affiliates of willowweave.co who perform service(s) on our behalf or process authorized transactions. We do not sell your information to any third party nor do we disclose your personal information to unaffiliated third parties.

Your Rights

You may request information about personal data we hold about you. If your data is incorrect, incomplete or irrelevant, you can ask to have the information corrected or removed.

Use of Cookies 

Cookie is a small text file that is saved to, and during subsequent visits retrieved from your computer or mobile device. A cookie is a piece of information that is held on the hard drive of your computer which records how you have used a website. Cookies make it easier for you to log on and use the website for next visits. There are two types of cookies i.e. permanent and temporary. Permanent cookies are stored as a file on your computer or mobile device for no longer than twelve months. Session cookies are stored temporarily and disappear when you close your browser session. Willowweave.co uses cookies to enhance and simplify your visit. We do not use cookies to store personal information or to disclose information to third parties. We use permanent cookies to store your choice of start page and to store your details. We use session cookies when you use the product filtration function and to check if you are logged in. You can easily erase cookies from your computer or mobile device using your browser.

Third Party Cookies

We also use non-personal data such as third-party cookies to collect statistics to enhance and simplify your visit. Willowweave.co use third-party cookies to collect statistics in aggregate form in analysis tools such as Google Analytics and Core Metrics.

refund-policy.title: Refund policy
refund-policy.bodyHtml:
Exchange & Return Policy

‘Willow Weave’ has a 7 days return policy, which means you have 7 days after receiving your item to request an exchange or return. To be eligible for a return, your item must be in the same condition in which you received, unworn/unused, with tags and in its original packing. You’ll also need receipt as proof of purchase. Since, we do not have a refund policy; therefore, we offer two options:-

- Exchange your article with any other item of the same price.

- Get voucher of the same amount for use during your next purchase.

Exchange or Return

The easiest way to proceed for an exchange or return is to contact us for return related question(s) at willowweave.co@gmail.com. If your return is accepted, we’ll send you a return shipping label and instructions on how and where to send your package. Once the return process is complete, then you may make a separate purchase for the new item(s).

Damages or Issues

Please inspect your order upon receipt and contact us immediately if the item is defective, damaged or if you receive the wrong item, so that we can evaluate the issue and make it right.

Exceptions/Non-returnable Items

Unfortunately, we cannot accept returns or exchanges on articles sold during sale or as a package or gift cards. Please get in touch prior to purchase, if you have questions or concerns about a specific item.

shipping-policy.title: Shipping policy
shipping-policy.bodyHtml:
Shipping Policy

Domestic Shipping (Within Pakistan)

All orders are processed within 1–3 business days (excluding weekends and public holidays).

Estimated Rates (Pakistan Post / Leopards Courier):

  • Up to 1 kg: Rs. 150

  • 1–3 kg: Rs. 270

  • 5–10 kg: Rs. 570

  • 10–20 kg: Rs. 750 to 1,300

Delivery Time: 2–5 business days (urban), 5–7 (remote areas)

International Shipping

We ship to the USA, UK, UAE, Canada, Australia, Europe, and selected countries.
Shipping charges are calculated at checkout.

Average Costs:

  • USA: ~Rs. 9,000

  • UK: ~Rs. 7,200

  • Asia: ~Rs. 5,500

Delivery Time: 7–14 business days (may vary by destination and customs)

Customs, Duties, and Taxes

Customs duties or GST (typically 17% and above) may apply based on your country’s laws. Customers are responsible for these charges.

Tracking and Claims

You will receive a tracking number within 24 hours of shipment.
For damaged items, please contact the courier directly and retain all original packaging.

International orders & currency

We ship internationally to selected countries with a per-country delivery charge shown at checkout. Prices displayed in currencies other than Pakistani Rupees (PKR) are converted from our original PKR prices using an exchange rate that we update weekly — displayed prices may therefore change over time as conversion rates fluctuate. Your order total is fixed at the rate shown when you place the order.

sizeChartSection.heading: Key Detail About Size Charts
sizeChartSection.bodyHtml:
Understanding the Size Charts

The size information provided represents measurements for fitted garments like typical shirts and trousers. These specific charts - covering dimensions like Chest, Waist Relaxed/Stretched, and overall Length - are intended to guide customers looking for a close-to-body fit. It is crucial to note that many suits and popular outfits available today feature loose shapes for a relaxed, comfortable, and contemporary look. Since the current trend often favors these looser styles, customers should use the provided charts primarily for fitted items and may need to check for specific relaxed-fit guides or consider their usual size for modern, roomy silhouettes.

care.label: Care
care.bodyHtml: To maintain the beauty and integrity of your purchase, we recommend treating it with care. Simple maintenance practices, such as gentle washing and proper storage, can effectively preserve the longevity of your favorites. We encourage you to refer to the care instructions included with each item, designed to help you keep your purchase in top condition.

design.label: Design
design.bodyHtml: Our dedication to excellence extends beyond materials; it encompasses the artistry and craftsmanship illustrated in every piece we create.
